natural: Riding a tiger and unable to get off

meaning.en: Unable to back out once committed; in too deep.
meaning.zh: 骑在老虎背上不能下来。比喻事情迫于形势，不能中止。

equivalents: have a tiger by the tail
past the point of no return

examples.zh: 项目投入了大笔资金，现在骑虎难下。
examples.en: We've sunk so much money into the project that there's no backing out now.

examples.zh: 话已经说出去了，他骑虎难下。
examples.en: Having said it publicly, he couldn't back down.

story.en: Wen Jiao urged a wavering ally to fight on: "The situation allows no retreat — once riding a fierce beast, how can one get off midway?" (骑猛兽，安可中下哉).
story.zh: 温峤说："今之事势，义无旋踵，骑猛兽，安可中下哉！"

natural: Throwing gold around like dirt

meaning.en: To spend money like water.
meaning.zh: 把钱财当泥土一样挥霍。形容极端挥霍浪费。

equivalents: money burns a hole in one's pocket

examples.zh: 他中了彩票后挥金如土，几年就花光了。
examples.en: After winning the lottery he spent money like water and blew it all in a few years.

examples.zh: 这些富二代挥金如土。
examples.en: These rich kids splash the cash.

natural: Given a peach, return a plum

meaning.en: To return a favour; reciprocity.
meaning.zh: 他送给我桃儿，我拿李子回送他。比喻友好往来。

equivalents: you scratch my back, I'll scratch yours

examples.zh: 他上次帮了我，这次我投桃报李。
examples.en: He helped me last time, so this time I'm returning the favour.

examples.zh: 两国投桃报李，关系越来越好。
examples.en: The two countries reciprocate each other's gestures, and relations keep improving.

story.en: The Book of Songs: "He threw me a peach; I repaid him with a plum" (投我以桃，报之以李).

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

natural: High standards in the eye, low skill in the hand

meaning.en: Having high standards but poor practical ability.
meaning.zh: 要求的标准很高，但实际上自己也做不到。

examples.zh: 有些毕业生眼高手低，看不上基础工作。
examples.en: Some graduates have high standards but poor skills, looking down on entry-level work.

examples.zh: 评论别人容易，自己做才知道眼高手低。
examples.en: It's easy to criticise others — try it yourself and you'll see your skills don't match your standards.

natural: Never forgetting what passes before the eyes

meaning.en: A photographic memory.
meaning.zh: 看过就不忘记。形容记忆力非常强。

examples.zh: 他有过目不忘的本领。
examples.en: He has a photographic memory.

examples.zh: 她读书过目不忘，背课文特别快。
examples.en: She remembers everything she reads and memorises texts very fast.

natural: An old illness flaring up again

meaning.en: An old illness or bad habit returns.
meaning.zh: 旧的疾病又复发了。也比喻老毛病、旧错误又重犯。

examples.zh: 天气一冷，爷爷的关节炎就旧病复发。
examples.en: As soon as it turns cold, Grandpa's arthritis flares up again.

examples.zh: 他戒烟半年，最近又旧病复发了。
examples.en: He gave up smoking for six months but has recently relapsed.

natural: Deep plans and far-sighted thinking

meaning.en: Far-sighted and carefully planned.
meaning.zh: 周密地计划，往长远里考虑。

examples.zh: 他深谋远虑，早就为退休做好了准备。
examples.en: Far-sighted, he prepared for retirement long ago.

examples.zh: 这一决策体现了领导者的深谋远虑。
examples.en: The decision shows the leader's far-sighted thinking.

story.en: Jia Yi's essay on the fall of Qin says the rebels' "deep plans and far-sighted strategy" (深谋远虑) were no match for earlier statesmen — yet they toppled Qin, because Qin lost the people.
story.zh: 贾谊《过秦论》："深谋远虑，行军用兵之道，非及向时之士也。"

antonyms: 脚踩西瓜皮——滑到哪里算哪里

natural: Beyond the divine, into the miraculous

meaning.en: Consummate; skill of supernatural perfection.
meaning.zh: 形容技艺达到了极其高超的境界。

examples.zh: 他的魔术表演出神入化。
examples.en: His magic act is pure magic.

examples.zh: 这位演员的表演已达到出神入化的境界。
examples.en: The actor's performance has reached sublime perfection.

natural: Stale words and worn-out tunes

meaning.en: Clichés; hackneyed talk.
meaning.zh: 陈旧而空泛的言论。

examples.zh: 他的发言全是陈词滥调。
examples.en: His speech was nothing but clichés.

examples.zh: 写作文要避免陈词滥调。
examples.en: Avoid clichés in your essays.

natural: Poor, distressed and down on one's luck

meaning.en: Destitute and down on one's luck.
meaning.zh: 生活贫困，失意颓丧。

examples.zh: 这位画家生前穷困潦倒，死后作品价值连城。
examples.en: The painter was down and out in life, but his works became priceless after his death.

examples.zh: 他晚年穷困潦倒。
examples.en: In his later years he was destitute.

natural: The six spirits have lost their master

meaning.en: Utterly distraught; not knowing what to do.
meaning.zh: 形容惊慌失措，拿不定主意。

examples.zh: 听说儿子出了车祸，她吓得六神无主。
examples.en: Hearing her son had had an accident, she was beside herself.

examples.zh: 突然停电，大家六神无主。
examples.en: The sudden blackout left everyone at a loss.

usage.en: Predicate or complement. The six spirits are those said to govern the heart, lungs, liver, kidneys, spleen and gallbladder.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。"六神"指道教所说主宰心、肺、肝、肾、脾、胆的神。

natural: Seizing the enemy's nerve with the first shout

meaning.en: To seize the initiative by first making a show of strength or momentum that overawes the opponent.
meaning.zh: 先张扬自己的声势以压倒对方。也比喻做事抢先一步。

equivalents: get off to a flying start

examples.zh: 主队开场三分钟就进球，先声夺人。
examples.en: The home team scored within three minutes — a flying start.

examples.zh: 这家公司提前发布新品，先声夺人。
examples.en: The company seized the initiative by releasing its new product early.

story.en: A Song general said: "The army of old had a saying: striking first takes the enemy's heart" (先人有夺人之心).
story.zh: 《左传》："军志有之：'先人有夺人之心，后人有待其衰。'"

natural: Execute first, report to the emperor later

meaning.en: To act first and ask permission later.
meaning.zh: 原指臣子先处决犯人，再向皇帝报告。比喻先把事情处理了再报告上级。

examples.zh: 他先斩后奏，辞了职才告诉家里。
examples.en: He quit his job first and told his family afterwards.

examples.zh: 这种先斩后奏的做法让领导很不满。
examples.en: The boss was unhappy with this act-first-ask-later approach.

natural: The road runs out at the end of the path

meaning.en: At the end of the road; in a hopeless position.
meaning.zh: 形容处境十分困窘，已经无路可走。

equivalents: at the end of the road
at the end of one's rope

examples.zh: 敌人已经穷途末路了。
examples.en: The enemy is at the end of the road.

examples.zh: 这家公司走到了穷途末路。
examples.en: The company has reached a dead end.

natural: An opportunity not to be lost

meaning.en: An opportunity not to be missed.
meaning.zh: 好的时机不可错过。

equivalents: strike while the iron is hot

examples.zh: 机不可失，失不再来。
examples.en: It's now or never — the chance won't come again.

examples.zh: 这么好的价格，机不可失。
examples.en: A price this good — don't miss out.

story.en: General Li Jing urged a swift attack: "In war, speed is prized; the opportunity must not be lost" (兵贵神速，机不可失).
story.zh: 李靖说："兵贵神速，机不可失。"

usage.en: Usually 机不可失，失不再来.
usage.zh: 常说"机不可失，失不再来"。

natural: Given an inch, take a foot

meaning.en: Give them an inch and they'll take a mile.
meaning.zh: 得了一寸，还想再进一尺。比喻贪心不足。

equivalents: give them an inch and they'll take a mile

examples.zh: 你让了他一次，他就得寸进尺。
examples.en: You gave in once and now he's taking a mile.

examples.zh: 对方得寸进尺，提出了更多要求。
examples.en: The other side pushed their luck with even more demands.

story.en: Fan Ju advised the King of Qin to befriend distant states and attack near ones, so that "every inch gained is Your Majesty's inch, every foot gained Your Majesty's foot".
story.zh: 范雎说："得寸则王之寸，得尺亦王之尺也。"原指稳步扩张，后指贪得无厌。

natural: Every blade of grass and tree a soldier

meaning.en: So frightened that one sees enemies everywhere.
meaning.zh: 把山上的草木都当作敌兵。形容人在惊慌时疑神疑鬼。

examples.zh: 被骗过几次后，他变得草木皆兵。
examples.en: After being scammed several times, he's become paranoid.

examples.zh: 谣言四起，市场上草木皆兵。
examples.en: With rumours flying, the market is jumping at shadows.

story.en: Before the Battle of Fei River, the Former Qin ruler Fu Jian looked out at Mount Bagong and mistook the grass and trees for Jin soldiers. He was then routed.
story.zh: 淝水之战前，苻坚登城望见晋军严整，又望八公山上草木，以为都是晋兵，心生恐惧。

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 风声鹤唳.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"风声鹤唳"连用。

natural: Empty, faint and far away

meaning.en: Illusory; vague and unreal.
meaning.zh: 形容空虚渺茫，不可捉摸。

examples.zh: 这种虚无缥缈的承诺不可信。
examples.en: Such vague promises can't be trusted.

examples.zh: 山顶云雾缭绕，宛如虚无缥缈的仙境。
examples.en: Wrapped in mist, the summit looks like an ethereal fairyland.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 缥缈 is piāomiǎo.

natural: Officials protecting one another

meaning.en: Officials shielding one another.
meaning.zh: 做官的人互相包庇。

examples.zh: 官官相护，老百姓有冤无处申。
examples.en: With officials covering for each other, ordinary people have nowhere to seek justice.

examples.zh: 要打破官官相护的潜规则。
examples.en: The unwritten rule of officials shielding each other must be broken.

natural: The mountains end and the waters run out

meaning.en: At the end of one's resources; nowhere left to turn.
meaning.zh: 山和水都到了尽头。比喻无路可走，陷入绝境。

equivalents: at the end of one's tether

examples.zh: 到了山穷水尽的地步，他才向家人求助。
examples.en: Only when he'd hit rock bottom did he ask his family for help.

examples.zh: 公司资金山穷水尽，只能宣布破产。
examples.en: With its funds completely exhausted, the company had to declare bankruptcy.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Opposite of 柳暗花明.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。与"柳暗花明"相对。

natural: Plenty of clothes and enough food

meaning.en: Well-fed and well-clothed; comfortably off.
meaning.zh: 穿的吃的都很丰富充足。形容生活富裕。

examples.zh: 村民们过上了丰衣足食的生活。
examples.en: The villagers now live comfortably, well fed and clothed.

examples.zh: 自己动手，丰衣足食。
examples.en: Do it yourself and you'll want for nothing.

natural: Baring fangs and brandishing claws

meaning.en: Menacing and ferocious; making threatening gestures.
meaning.zh: 形容猛兽凶恶可怕，也比喻猖狂凶恶的样子。

examples.zh: 那只狗张牙舞爪地向我扑来。
examples.en: The dog lunged at me, teeth bared.

examples.zh: 别看他张牙舞爪的，其实很胆小。
examples.en: He may look menacing, but he's actually a coward.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. 爪 is zhǎo here.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。"爪"读 zhǎo。

natural: The blazing summer sun

meaning.en: The scorching heat of summer.
meaning.zh: 夏天阳光灼热，天气炎热。

examples.zh: 夏日炎炎，来一碗冰镇绿豆汤最舒服。
examples.en: In the scorching summer heat, a bowl of iced mung-bean soup is perfect.

examples.zh: 夏日炎炎，工人们仍坚持在工地上工作。
examples.en: Despite the blazing summer heat, the workers kept at it on site.

usage.en: Usually an opening phrase setting the scene. A descriptive 四字词语 rather than a classical idiom.

natural: Page after page and tablet upon tablet

meaning.en: Long-winded; page after page of writing.
meaning.zh: 形容篇幅过多，文辞冗长。

examples.zh: 媒体连篇累牍地报道这起事件。
examples.en: The media reported the incident at enormous length.

examples.zh: 报告连篇累牍，却没说清问题。
examples.en: The report goes on for pages but never makes the problem clear.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. 累 is lěi; 牍 = writing tablet.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。"累"读 lěi。

natural: Abandoning the root to chase the branches

meaning.en: To neglect the essentials and pursue trivia.
meaning.zh: 抛弃根本的、主要的，而去追求细枝末节。

equivalents: put the cart before the horse
miss the wood for the trees

examples.zh: 只重包装不重质量，是舍本逐末。
examples.en: Caring about packaging rather than quality is putting the cart before the horse.

examples.zh: 学习不能舍本逐末，基础最重要。
examples.en: Don't neglect the essentials — the basics matter most.

story.en: The text warns that when "the people abandon the root (farming) and pursue the branches (trade)" (民舍本而事末), they become disobedient — an early statement of agrarian priorities.
story.zh: 《吕氏春秋·上农》："民舍本而事末则不令。"原指弃农经商。
